meta_description:
6,025 likes, 48 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 22, 2026: "AI is cute, but this end result is so charming! 

So we took this trend a step forward to showcase how to actually film it. You’ll need a phone and a phone gimbal. Set it to 

✏️ 0.5x lens 
✏️ 4K 60 fps 
✏️ Walk around your subject at a normal pace and 
✏️ Pause for 2s at each unique position 
✏️ Subject has to keep staring at the camera
✏️ In editing, place cuts between the 2s pauses and speed up the footage in those segments to get the final result! 

And for more inspiration and learning from @tanyakhanijow, join our next live workshop on 26th Sept 2026, 10 AM. 

Link is in Bio".
